basis: Item 8 draft, 2026-10-29. A strong one-sided shadow on a bright candidate: two_sided at or above 4.0 (q0.999 of bright false alarms is 4.09) and a shadow run reading as 0.5 to 3 m of height. Bright branch only: the shadow branch already selects on this and its false alarms all have one. Kept beside the adopted saturation rule.

rules.name: shadow_strong
rules.basis: dark on the anti-sun side only, far beyond what polygon troughs and slopes produce, with a length that reads as a 0.5 to 3 m object
